title: New York federal judge denies Novig’s injunction bid, rules its sports event contracts are not swaps
summary: A federal judge ruled New York can enforce gambling laws against Novig after finding its sports contracts are not swaps.
content: A New York federal judge has denied Novig’s bid for an injunction, ruling that the company's sports event contracts do not qualify as swaps. The decision allows New York to enforce its state gambling laws against Novig, dealing a setback to the platform's attempts to operate under alternative regulatory definitions.
content_ta: Novig-ன் தடை உத்தரவு கோரிய மனுவை New York பெடரல் நீதிபதி தள்ளுபடி செய்துள்ளார். நிறுவனத்தின் sports event ஒப்பந்தங்கள் swaps அல்ல என்று தீர்ப்பளித்துள்ளார். இதன் மூலம் New York-ல் உள்ள சூதாட்ட சட்டங்களை Novig மீது அமல்படுத்த வழிவகை செய்யப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: OpenAI posts $11B loss despite $10B revenue surge: WSJ
summary:
OpenAI's financial trajectory raises concerns about its long-term viability, with potential solvency issues if current trends persist.
The post OpenAI posts $11B loss despite $10B revenue surge: WSJ appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: OpenAI has reportedly recorded a significant $11 billion loss despite experiencing a massive $10 billion revenue surge, according to a recent Wall Street Journal report. This financial trajectory has sparked concerns within the industry regarding the long-term viability and potential solvency issues of the artificial intelligence firm if these current spending and growth trends continue over time.
content_ta: Wall Street Journal அறிக்கையின்படி, OpenAI நிறுவனம் பத்தப் பில்லியன் டாலர் வருவாய் அதிகரிப்பைப் பெற்ற போதிலும், பதினொரு பில்லியன் டாலர் நஷ்டத்தைச் சந்தித்துள்ளதாகத் தெரிவிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இந்த நிதி நிலை போக்கு, நிறுவனத்தின் நீண்டகால நிலைத்தன்மை மற்றும் எதிர்காலச் solvency சிக்கல்கள் குறித்த கவலைகளை எழுப்பியுள்ளது.

title: Wirex Strengthens UK Board With Appointment of Julian Sawyer as Independent Non-Executive Director
summary:
Wirex Limited, the UK headquartered payments provider, has appointed Julian Sawyer, co-founder and former Chief Operating Officer of Starling Bank, to the Board as an Independent Non-Executive Director. 
Sawyer brings experience across digital banking, payments and digital assets. As an Independent Non-Executive Director, he will provide independent oversight and challenge to the Board, including on strategy, risk and controls, and customer oversight.  
Sawyer co-founded Starling Bank in 2015 and served as its Chief Operating Officer until 2019, leading the bank’s operations, including its card launch and Starling Payment Services, its platform giving other firms access to UK payment schemes. He went on to become Managing Director, Europe at Gemini, and then Chief Executive Officer of Bitstamp and Zodia Custody, and is an Independent Non-Executive Director of Recognise Bank. 
Chetan Shah, CEO of Wirex Limited, said: “I’m delighted to welcome Julian to the Board of Wirex Limited. He has built and run some of the UK’s most successful, regulated financial businesses from the ground up, and his independent perspective will help Wirex to continue growing safely and sustainably. The UK has been our home for over a decade, and at such an important time for the UK payment sector, I look forward to working closely with Julian on the opportunities ahead.” 
Julian Sawyer said: “Having worked across banking and payments, I’ve seen how much the industry has matured. The next generation of financial services in the UK will be built on the foundations of trust, sound regulation and reliable infrastructure, and I’m excited to join the Board to supporting the Wirex team as they continue to implement that, with a strong focus on governance and customer outcomes as the business grows.” 
On 12th November, Julian will be speaking at Full Stack London, Wirex’s new stablecoin infrastructure conference, a one-day, closed-door event where founders, CEOs and technical builders can discuss what it takes to make stablecoins work in payments. Opposite Wirex’s CCO, Daniel Rowlands, they’ll discuss why infrastructure provider models fail, and lessons from the industry, in a fireside chat. 
Sawyer’s appointment follows that of Kulveer Ranger, The Lord Ranger of Northwood, as Board Adviser to Wirex Labs earlier this week, as Wirex builds out its leadership for its next stage of growth. 
NoYesPeople Moves11 Nov, 2026
content: Wirex Limited has appointed Julian Sawyer as an Independent Non-Executive Director to its UK Board. Sawyer, co-founder of Starling Bank and former executive at Gemini, Bitstamp, and Zodia Custody, brings extensive digital banking and payments experience. The appointment aims to provide strategic oversight and support the company's sustainable growth in the UK market.
content_ta: UK-ஐ தலைமையிடமாகக் கொண்ட payments provider நிறுவனமான Wirex, தனது UK Board-க்கு Independent Non-Executive Director-ஆக Julian Sawyer-ஐ நியமித்துள்ளது. Starling Bank-ன் co-founder மற்றும் Gemini, Bitstamp நிறுவனங்களில் முக்கிய பொறுப்புகளை வகித்த Sawyer, digital banking மற்றும் payments துறையில் ஆழ்ந்த அனுபவம் கொண்டவர். இந்நிறுவனத்தின் வளர்ச்சிக்கு strategic oversight வழங்குவதை இந்த நியமனம் நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது.

title: HTX Releases October Performance Report: Spot Liquidity Significantly Enhanced, APY Boosts Help Users Through a Warm Winter
summary: Since the start of Q4, the crypto market has continued to weaken amid volatility. Major asset prices have pulled back from their highs, and market participants have become more cautious. As the market cools, HTX has focused its efforts on solidifying its trading fundamentals and offering diverse yield generation pathways. In October, HTX saw a significant overall improvement in the market depth of its core spot trading pairs, with the 0.05% depth for the BTC/USDT pair increasing by 78%. Meanwhile, the platform’s total count  of stock trading assets grew to 307, with cumulative TradFi trading volume surpassing 7.5 billion USDT. At the end of October, HTX Earn launched the APY Boost Promotion as part of the HTX Winter Campaign, delivering stable yield options for users amid fluctuating market conditions. Overall Spot Depth Enhancement, Ensuring Smoother Execution for Large-Volume Trades In October, HTX continued to strengthen its collaboration with professional market makers, improving market-making support, order book depth, and the overall trading environment, which contributed to an overall improvement in the market depth of its core spot trading pairs. Taking BTC/USDT as an example, the pair’s 0.01% depth increased by 42% in October, while its 0.05% depth jumped by 78%. Deeper market depth ensures that orders of the same size have a smaller price impact, allowing large-volume trades to be executed closer to market price. For core assets like BTC, this means users can easily execute trades even during periods of severe market volatility. Centered around the two core assets of BTC and ETH, HTX also rolled out a series of trading rewards in October, including trading challenges, fee rebates, trading lucky draws, and iPhone Duo theme activities, with the flagship trading challenge attracting over 10,000 participants. Asset Matrix Continues to Expand, Stock Trading Assets Reach 307 Types In October, HTX Futures launched 40 new assets, including 29 selected stocks and ETFs alongside 11 crypto assets. To date, the platform’s number of stock trading assets has grown to 307, covering core US stocks, major global indices and ETFs, biopharmaceuticals, energy infrastructure, and Asia-Pacific market leaders. Overall platform liquidity and user activity have both reached new highs. This month’s new listings focused on sectors including AI computing power and hardware innovation, biopharmaceuticals and healthcare, mass consumption and high-dividend blue chips, as well as Asia-Pacific core markets and frontier technologies. Targets such as STMicroelectronics (STM), United Microelectronics (UMC), Synopsys (SNPS), Constellation Energy (CEG), Pfizer (PFE), Boeing (BA), Procter & Gamble (PG), McDonald’s (MCD), Starbucks (SBUX), Indonesia Index ETF (EIDO), and Taiyo Yuden (TAIYOYUDEN) were rolled out in succession, offering a balanced mix of growth-oriented tech stocks and defensive assets like consumer goods and pharmaceuticals. As HTX continues to expand its asset offerings, cumulative TradFi trading volume has surpassed $7.5 billion, with $1.5 billion added in October alone. In the spot asset category, new listings introduced by HTX in October primarily centered around the AI sector, featuring projects such as POD, AXIS, DNA, and NMR. Notably, Axis Robotics (AXIS), which focuses on physical AI and robotics training data, was jointly launched as a primary listing by HTX, surging by up to 37% following its debut. HTX Earn Offers APY Boost on 7 Products, USDT Loan Rates Maintain Strong Competitiveness In October, user interest in HTX Earn continued to rise. SVIP Flexible subscriptions among users with large holdings remained exceptionally popular, with participating users increasing by 16.1% month-on-month and subscription volume surging by over 20% month-on-month. On October 31, HTX Earn launched an APY Boost Promotion as part of the HTX Winter Campaign. The promotion offers APY boosts on 7-day fixed products featuring an APY of up to 10% for three mainstream coins (BTC, ETH, TRX) and four stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USDS, USDD). Each user can subscribe for up to 2 million USDT worth of each respective asset in the 7-day fixed product for that asset. By subscribing to all seven assets, a user can access a combined  boosted APY quota of up to approximately 14 million USDT, fully accommodating the asset allocation needs of users with large holdings. After the products mature, users can subscribe again, ensuring strong liquidity for their funds. In terms of borrowing, HTX’s USDT loan interest rates maintained robust competitiveness across the industry. In October, the platform’s annualized USDT loan interest rate ranged from 4.75% to 5.3%, with discounted rates for large-volume borrowers as low as 3.84%, empowering users to unlock the capital potential of their holdings at lower costs. During the HTX Margin Autumn Craze, USDT loan scale grew by 18.6% month-on-month, and margin trading volume surged by over 128%. Currently, the HTX Margin Trading & Borrowing Bonanza Month is underway and will run through November 25, offering 7 tiers of rewards for USDT loans alongside up to a 50% fee rebate on trades during the Margin Trading Contest. In the OTC sector, HTX has continued to expand payment channels for its OTC Desk, partnering with multiple payment providers to further optimize the user trading experience and reduce transaction costs. $HTX Q3 Burn Performance Shines, TOKEN2049 Spotlights Brand Influence On October 15, HTX DAO completed its $HTX token burn for Q3 2026. A total of approximately 9.39 trillion $HTX tokens were burned, valued at roughly $15.48 million, representing a quarter-over-quarter burn volume increase of approximately 25.6%. This brings the cumulative total of $HTX burned and pledged to 127.17 trillion tokens to date. Under HTX DAO’s established mechanism, HTX acts as an ecosystem partner, dedicating 50% of its quarterly revenues to $HTX buybacks and burns. From October 6 to 8, global crypto attention converged on TOKEN2049 in Singapore. HTX Ventures, the global investment arm of HTX, made its presence felt at the Sands Expo and Convention Center in Singapore, where Unitree robots and Huobao (HTX mascot) IP parades, and multiple targeted lucky draws attracted large crowds of visitors . Meanwhile, HTX DAO hosted multiple sideline events during the summit. At HTX DAO Future Night, Justin Sun, Advisor to HTX and a core supporter of HTX DAO, delivered a video address sharing perspectives on crypto industry trends and the future development of the digital economy, highlighting the free flow of value within the digital world as a major trend worth watching over the coming decade. At the VIP private dinner, the HTX team engaged in deep dialogues with industry representatives, ecosystem contributors, and partners, exchanging viewpoints on industry evolution, market shifts, and product experiences to foster mutual understanding while optimizing services and expanding collaborations. Standing by Users Through Every Market Cycle Markets fluctuate. Facing market ups and downs, what the platform can do for users is deliver a better trading experience with each transaction, introduce valuable innovative products and practical rewards, and firmly safeguard user asset security. Compliance is the foundation of all these efforts. In October, HTX continued to deepen constructive communication with relevant regulatory authorities and work toward the proper resolution of relevant matters, while further strengthening its compliance measures. These efforts create more favorable conditions for focusing on user services and pursuing long-term development. Over the past 13 years, HTX has weathered market cycles one after another alongside users worldwide. This winter, HTX will continue to uphold a user-first philosophy, accompanying every user through the cold season and awaiting the arrival of the next cycle together.   About HTX Founded in 2013, HTX has evolved from a virtual asset exchange into a comprehensive ecosystem of blockchain businesses that span digital asset trading, derivatives, research, investments, incubation, and other businesses. Guided by its vision to “Achieve Financial Freedom for 8 Billion People Worldwide,” HTX works to make the digital asset space more accessible to a broader audience. The platform continues to develop its products and services in response to user needs and an evolving industry landscape. To learn more about HTX, please visit https://www.htx.com/ or HTX Square , and follow HTX on X, Telegram, andDiscord. For further inquiries, please contact glo-media@htx-inc.com.
content: HTX released its October performance report, highlighting significant improvements in spot liquidity, an expanding asset matrix reaching 307 stock trading assets, and the launch of the HTX Earn APY Boost Promotion. The platform also reported strong Q3 token burn performance by HTX DAO and active engagement at global industry events like TOKEN2049, reinforcing its commitment to user-focused trading fundamentals and compliance amid market volatility.

title: Wise Expands U.S. Product Suite, Giving Customers New Ways to Earn Returns
summary:
Wise, the global technology company building the best way to move and manage the world's money, today announced an expansion of its US product offering, giving people and businesses two new ways to earn a return on the money they hold with Wise.
The expansion introduces Wise Interest and Stocks, two new products available directly from customers' existing USD balance. Unlike traditional alternatives that require customers to move or lock away their money to earn a return, customers who opt in to these products keep instant access to their funds, meaning they can continue to send and spend from the same balance with no withdrawal penalties. Wise Interest and Stocks are offered by Wise US Assets Inc., a registered broker-dealer. Member of SIPC, which protects securities customers of its members up to $500,000 (including $250,000 for claims for cash). 
Vinay Nilakantan, Head of Product for North America at Wise, said: "People and businesses around the world are keeping more money with Wise than ever. Global customer holdings grew 40% to $39 billion last financial year alone. Now, we want to offer Wise customers more ways to put that money to work, without compromising the convenience and flexibility they expect from us.
"In the US, earning a competitive return too often means locking your money away or juggling multiple accounts. But with Wise Interest and Stocks, people and businesses in the US no longer have to choose between making their money work harder and actually being able to use it. They have the freedom to do both."
Introducing new ways for Wise customers to earn a return
Wise Interest allows customers to earn a return on USD held with Wise through a money market fund holding government-backed assets. Customers' money remains instantly available to send and spend within the same balance, offering greater convenience and flexibility. Returns, which are not guaranteed, are calculated daily and paid into customers' accounts monthly, and over 90% of returns earned may also be exempt from state and local income taxes.
For customers looking for potential longer-term returns, Stocks gives people and businesses a simple way to invest money held with Wise in an S&P 500 index fund. This lets them invest across a diverse range of leading US companies while keeping a high degree of liquidity. Investing involves risk, including possible loss of principal. Wise Interest seeks to preserve the value of an investment, but the investment value of Stocks will change with the market.
Customers can start using either product directly from their existing USD balances by simply selecting Wise Interest or Stocks. In line with Wise's commitment to transparency and low costs, customers will see the fees associated with each product clearly before opting in.
Expanding Wise's existing US product suite
The launch comes as customers increasingly use Wise to hold more of their money and look for more ways to grow those funds. Income earned by US customers through Wise's existing Basic Interest offering, which allows customers in the US to receive interest on USD, GBP and EUR, increased by almost 17% year over year in FY26. Basic Interest is an opt-in feature that allows customers to earn interest on eligible balances held in a Wise account with Wise US Inc. Customer funds are held at Wise US Inc.'s program bank, which pays interest on those funds, and a portion of that interest is passed through to eligible customers.
Wise Interest and Stocks build on the range of existing products already available to Wise personal and business customers in the US. Today, customers can hold and convert more than 40 currencies, get paid in nine currencies using local account details, send money internationally with 77% of payments arriving instantly (in under 20 seconds), and spend around the world with the Wise Multi-Currency Card.
The launch of Wise Interest and Stocks marks the first time Wise has operationalized its US broker-dealer license, which it holds in all 50 states, to offer more tailored products to local customers.

content: Wise has expanded its US product suite by introducing Wise Interest and Stocks, giving customers new ways to earn returns on their USD balances. The new products allow individuals and businesses to earn a return through money market funds and an S&P 500 index fund while maintaining instant access to their funds for spending and transfers, without withdrawal penalties or locking away their money.

Wise Interest மற்றும் Stocks என்ற இந்த புதிய தயாரிப்புகள் மூலம் வாடிக்கையாளர்கள் தங்கள் பணத்தை முடக்கி வைக்காமல், உடனடியாக செலவழிக்கவும் அதே நேரத்தில் முதலீடுகள் மூலம் வருமானம் ஈட்டவும் முடியும்.
